free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0 with no credit card: 1 project, 1 environment, 0.1 vCPU, 256 MiB of RAM and 1 GB of storage, with zero-downtime deploys, HTTPS and a global CDN and 1 day of log retention. Hosting beyond the plan is metered per second.

egress.terms: Metered on every plan at USD 0.00012 per MB of egress; no free egress allowance is stated on the pricing page

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: 0.1 vCPU and 256 MiB is smaller than a Streamlit app but it is a real always-on container with a CDN, so it fits an API or a webhook receiver that must answer when nothing else is awake; the 1 GB disk is the ceiling for anything stateful.

limits.value: 0.1 vCPU and 256 MiB is a single small service; there is no second project and no second environment on the free plan, so the limit is shape and count rather than a meter.
